elements.element: The transition obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Licensor must provide transition assistance to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) requires Licensor, at Licensee’s request, to “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) expressly provides assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Licensor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) expressly states “at Licensor’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Licensor must return Licensee Data to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires Licensor to “return all data submitted by or on behalf of Licensee or processed for Licensee” and defines it as “Licensee Data.”

elements.element: Licensee Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The introductory expiry-or-termination trigger applies to clause (b), which requires return “within thirty (30) days.”

elements.element: Licensee Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires return in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” satisfying the requirement for a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: After returning Licensee Data, Licensor must delete it.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires Licensor, “after such return,” to “delete Licensee Data from its systems.”

elements.element: After deleting Licensee Data, Licensor must certify the deletion.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires Licensor to “certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Licensor must provide transition assistance for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance for up to six months at Licensee’s request, which includes the fallback period of ninety days.

elements.element: Licensor must export Licensee Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires all Licensee Data to be returned in a commonly used, machine-readable format within thirty days, satisfying the data-export requirement.

result.reason: The added operative language fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It is limited to transition assistance, data return, deletion, and certification, without changing unrelated commercial terms or contradicting the existing return obligations.
